caption: A task in plain words, sent from Clank's agent panel. The model on this PC's GPU (frontier 262K lean, a 27B model) read the project and wrote todo/limits.py; in review mode the change waits beside your files: Allow once, Always or Reject.
Allowed, it wires the limiter into the server, writes the tests and runs them in the folder's container: all 9 pass. It runs them three more times, to be sure the concurrent test is not flaky.
Done, with what it changed, in its own words. Under the panel, the readout: 45 tok/s, 32K of the 262K window, the GPU's memory.
